players.product: EcoStruxure UPS, PDU, prefab modular datacenter blocks

quarterly_data.signal: Schneider Electric announced a strategic collaboration with NVIDIA and HPE on Physical AI for process industries and, as an initial demonstration, introduced Industrial AI Agents at the Edge (which it calls the industry's first): OT monitoring, cybersecurity and energy optimization agents built on HPE Private Cloud AI with NVIDIA Nemotron open models, deployed and governed through Schneider's EcoStruxure Industrial Insights apps. Named existing customer: CMPC Chile (part of Empresas CMPC) has used Schneider's OT Monitoring System (OTMS) in production for three years to monitor control systems across its pulp and paper operations.
